question: What is the meaning of mass fraction of pre-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass in relation to recycled materials?
data_point: mass fraction of pre-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass
description: The mass fraction of pre-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass refers to the proportion of recycled materials that have been reprocessed from waste material diverted from manufacturing processes, excluding reutilization of materials such as rework, regrind, or scrap generated in the same process. This term is used in the context of sustainable construction and environmental management to assess the amount of recycled content in a product.
